notes.title: Soundtrack Available Now as DLC and Small Update
notes.content:
For those who can’t enough of the haunting atmospheric in-game music, the original soundtrack containing well over an hour of music is now available for puchase at $ 2.99.

A small patch was also pushed this weekend:
-	Character models updated with highly detailed versions
-	Fixed a visual glitch causing screen image to not fit into the screen on different (larger) resolutions.
